name: Sovereign Resident Source Refresh
purpose: Invoke the already-proven local-only sovereign WorkerCoordinator source refresh as a reusable task, preserving mutable runtime state and emitting authentic refresh or boundary evidence without creating a new runtime owner.
trigger: a consuming Goal Task requires already-local canonical source to be refreshed into its existing sovereign resident runtime
scope: one already-local canonical source root and one existing sovereign runtime root
reuse_instructions: Trigger once through the canonical reusable-task lifecycle. Runtime availability is an execution boundary of this reusable task, not a task-specific prerequisite to be reimplemented by consumers. Reuse scripts/refresh_sovereign_worker_runtime_source.py; do not create another source refresher, runtime owner, scheduler, credential route, or source transport.
